title: I built an index of games shared here
author: adonislu
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I recently joined after a friend who’s making a game introduced me to this community. I wanted to explore the games people have shared without scrolling through older posts, so I made (vibecoded, haha) a small site called [Playtrace](https://playtrace.neorgon.com/).

It brings projects together with links to their original posts and credits the people who shared them. I thought it could also help others find projects similar to what they’re building.

Here’s the [site](https://playtrace.neorgon.com/) and the [source code](https://github.com/energon-a-secas/playtrace-site). It uses GitHub Pages, the Arctic Shift Reddit archive, and Cloudflare Workers + D1. And at least for now it's just considering shared projects of the current month.

And if you’re wondering about Neorgon, it’s just the main domain I use for my personal side projects.

Cheers!
